purpose: Teach: 補う/それでいて/ひっそり/おおよそ/あとがき/困惑/カラダ/集い

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがばあさんの不足を補う方法を考えてくださったぞ, 本気で
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he figured out ways to help you with what you were struggling with. Seriously.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Unhurried, each phrase landing with quiet weight. Warm undertone beneath the wistfulness, like turning pages of an old photo album.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃんは厳しくて、それでいて優しいお方でしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — your grandfather was strict, but he was such a gentle man, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle affirmation, voice lilting slightly on the question mark. A small smile lives in the tone. Searching his face as she speaks, checking if he remembers the same kindness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、田舎の村はひっそりしてたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when we were young, the village in the countryside was so quiet and still.
lines.style: Voice softens further, slowing into the quietness he's describing. Slight exhale before 'quiet,' as if remembering the peace of it. Almost a sigh for something distant in time.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、おおよその家計を毎月計算されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather calculated the household budget every month, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Appreciative, matter-of-fact warmth. Small note of admiration woven through — respect for the careful work he did. Gentle interrogative lilt, but certain of the answer.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんの日記のあとがきが面白かったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, the footnotes in your father's diary were so interesting.
lines.style: A small internal smile surfaces in the voice. Curious, almost delighted by the memory. Slower delivery, as if reading those footnotes again in his mind.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、新しい仕組みに困惑されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather was troubled by the new ways of doing things, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Sympathetic understanding, voice warm but knowing. Not quite a question — more gently acknowledging something they both witnessed. A thread of compassion for his struggle with change.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがカラダを鍛えてらしたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, your father was always training his body, working to stay strong.
lines.style: Slight note of admiration in the tone. Steady, approving. A memory of discipline and care. Voice firm but not harsh — respect for the effort.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご親戚の集いをお喜びだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather loved when the relatives would gather, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Voice brightens slightly, warmth spreading. Close and intimate, like she's sharing a secret she knows he'll recognize. Tender certainty in the question — she knows the answer already.
